verses: Aey eman walay logo! Allah aur uss kay rasool say aagay na barho aur Allah say dartay raha kero. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa sunnay wala, jannay wala hai

Aey eman walo! apni aawazen nabi ki awaz say upper na kero aur na unn say unchi awaz say baat kero jaisay aapas mein aik doosray say kertay ho, kahen (aisa na ho kay) tumharay aemaal ikaarat jayen aur tumhen khabar bhi na ho

Be-shak jo log rasool Allah (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) kay huzoor mein apni aawazen pust rakhtay hain, yehi woh log hain jin kay dilon ko Allah ney perhezgari kay liye jaanch liya hai. Unn kay liye maghfirat hai aur bara sawab hai
Jo log aap ko hujron kay peechay say pukartay hain unn mein say aksar (bilkul) bey aqal hain
Agar yeh log yahan tak sabar kertay kay aap khud say nikal ker unn kay pass aajatay to yehi unn kay liye behtar hota, aur Allah ghafoor o raheem hai
Aey musalmano! agar tumhen koi fasiq khabar dey to tum uss ki achi tarah tehqeeq ker liya kero aisa na ho kay nadani mein kissi qom ko ezza phoncha do phir apney kiye per pasheymani uthao

Aur jaan rakho kay tum mein Allah kay rasool mojood hain, agar woh tumhara kaha kertay rahey boht umoor mein, to tum mushkil mein par lekin Allah Taalaa ney eman ko tumharay liye mehboob bana diya hai aur ussay tumharay dilon mein zeenat dey rakhi hai aur kufur ko aur gunah ko aur na-farmani ko tumharay nigahon mein napasandeedah bana diya hai, yehi log raah yafta hain
Allah kay ehsan o inam say aur Allah dana aur ba-hikmat hai

Aur agar musalmanon ki do jamaten aapas mein larr paren to unn mein mail milaap kera diya kero. Phir agar unn dono mein say aik jamat doosri jamat per ziyadti keray to tum (sab) uss giroh say jo ziyadti kerta hai laro. Yahan tak kay woh Allah kay hukum ki taraf lot aaye, agar lot aaye to phir insaf kay sath sulah kera do aur adal kero be-shak Allah Taalaa insaf kerney walon say mohabbat kerta hai
(yaad rakho) saray musalman bhai bhai hain pus apney do bhaiyon mein milaap kera diya kero, aur Allah say dartay raho takay tum per reham kiya jaye

Aey eman walo! mard doosray mardon ka mazaq na urayen mumkin hai kay yeh unn say behtar ho aur na aurten aurton ka mazaq urayen mumkin hai yeh unn say behtar hun, aur aapas mein aik doosray ko aib na lagao aur na kissi ko buray laqab do. Eman kay baad fisq bura naam hai, aur jo tauba na keren o hi zalim log hain

Aey eman walo! boht badgumaaniyon say bacho yaqeen mano kay baaz bad-gumaniyan gunah hain. Aur bhed na tatola kero aur na tum mein say koi kissi ki gheebat keray. Kiya tum mein say koi bhi apney murdah bhai ka gosht khana pasand kerta hai? Tum ko uss say ghun aaye gi, aur Allah say dartay raho, be-shak Allah tauba qabool kerney wala meharban hai

Aey logo! hum ney tum sab ko aik (hi) mard o aurat say peda kiya hai aur uss liye kay tum aapas mein aik doosray ko pehchano kunbay aur qabeelay bana diye hain, Allah kay nazdeek tum sab mein ba-izzat woh hai jo sab say ziyadah darney wala hai. Yaqeen mano kay Allah dana aur ba-khabar hai

Dehaati log kehtay hain kay hum eman laye. Aap keh dijiye kay dar-haqeeqat tum eman nahi laye lekin tum yun kaho kay hum islam laye (mukhalifat chor ker mutee hogaye) halankay abhi tak tumharay dilon mein eman dakhil hi nahi hua. Tum agar Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki farmanbardari kerney lago gay to Allah tumharay aemaal mein say kuch bhi kum na keray ga. Be-shak Allah bakhshney wala meharban hai

Momin to woh hain jo Allah aur uss kay rasool per (pakka) eman layen phir shak o shuba)yeh na keren aur apney maalon say aur apni janon say Allah ki raah mein jihad kertay rahen, (apney dawa-e eman mein) yehi sachay aur raast go hain
Keh dijiye! kay kiya tum Allah Taalaa ko apni deendari say aagah ker rahey ho, Allah her uss cheez say jo aasmano mein aur zamin mein hai bakhoobi aagah hai. Aur Allah her cheez ka jannay wala hai

Apney musalman honey ka aap per ehsan jatatay hain. Aap keh dijiye kay apney musalman honey ka ehsan mujh per na rakho, balkay)yeh dar-asal Allah ka tum per ehsan hai kay uss ney tumhen eman ki hidayat ki agar tum raast go ho
Yaqeen mano kay aasmano aur zamin ki posheedah baaten Allah khoob janta hai. Aur jo kuch tum ker rahey ho ussay Allah khoob dekh raha hai
